Reading in data
```{r}
hddata <- 
  read_excel('/Users/gyaama/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Capstone/Capstone Data/CapstoneDataMerged_HDWorkingCopy.xlsx', na = c("", "Missing", "NA", "99"))

#visualize data in a tibble
head(hddata)

```

Tidying Data further, for variables of interest for descriptives
1-Selecting rows necessary for descriptives table

```{r}

descriptivesdataHD <- hddata |>
  select(c("record_id", "arm","Age", "Sex","q24c", "Race/Ethnicity", "SelfReportedHealth", "Confidence_Internet"))

head(descriptivesdataHD)
```

2-Running basic summary statistics, frequencies on descriptivesdata
#Age
```{r}

summary(descriptivesdataHD$Age)

table(descriptivesdataHD$Age)

class(descriptivesdataHD$Age)
```

#Sex
```{r}

table(descriptivesdataHD$Sex)
```


#Race/Eth
```{r}
table(descriptivesdataHD$`Race/Ethnicity`)
```

#Self Reported Health

```{r}
table(descriptivesdataHD$SelfReportedHealth)
```

#Internet Confidence
```{r}
table(descriptivesdataHD$Confidence_Internet)
```


3-Transforming Age into Age ranges varibale
```{r}
descriptivesdataHD <- descriptivesdataHD |>
  mutate(AgeRange = case_when(
    Age <= "65" ~ "60-65",
    Age >"65" & Age <="70" ~ "66-70",
    Age >"70" & Age <="75" ~ "71-75",
    Age >"75" & Age <="80" ~ "76-80",
    Age >"80"  ~ "81+",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

table(descriptivesdataHD$AgeRange, useNA = "ifany")

```


4-Tranforming Race/Eth
```{r}
descriptivesdataHD <- descriptivesdataHD |>
  mutate(Race_Eth = case_when(
   `Race/Ethnicity` == "Black" ~ "Black",
   `Race/Ethnicity` == "White" ~ "White",
   `Race/Ethnicity` == "NA" ~ "NA",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

table(descriptivesdataHD$Race_Eth, useNA = "ifany")
```


5-Transforming rural /urban, using RUCA classification
```{r}
#importing MO RUCA dataset

ruca <- read_excel('/Users/gyaama/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Capstone/Capstone Data/IL_MOZipcodesRUCA.xlsx')

ruca_clean <- ruca |>
  mutate(zipcode = as.character(ZIPCode),
        ) |>
  select(zipcode, PrimaryRUCA)

#left join or w/e

descriptivesdataHD <- descriptivesdataHD |>
  mutate(zipcode = as.character(q24c)) |>
  left_join(ruca_clean, by = "zipcode")


#categoriizng

# 4. Classify the codes
descriptivesdataHD <- descriptivesdataHD |>
  mutate(Rurality = case_when(
    is.na(PrimaryRUCA) ~ NA_character_,
    PrimaryRUCA <= 3 ~ "Urban",
    PrimaryRUCA <= 10 ~ "Rural"
  ))

table(descriptivesdataHD$Rurality, useNA = "ifany")
sum(is.na(descriptivesdataHD$PrimaryRUCA))
```

unique(descriptivesdata$Confidence_Internet)

6-Setting levels and labels
```{r}
descriptivesdataHD <- descriptivesdataHD |>
  mutate(
    AgeRange = factor(AgeRange,
                      levels = c("60-65", "66-70", "71-75", "76-80", "81+")),
    Race_Eth = factor(Race_Eth,
                      levels = c("White", "Black", "Other", "NA")),
    Rurality = factor(Rurality,
                      levels = c("Urban", "Semirural", "Rural")),
    Confidence_Internet = factor(Confidence_Internet,
                                 levels = c("Very confident", "Somewhat confident", "Only a litle confident",  "Not at all confident", "NA")),
    SelfReportedHealth = factor(SelfReportedHealth,
                                      levels = c("Excellent", "Very Good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")))
```


6-Building Table_General
```{r}
table1(~ AgeRange + Sex + Rurality + Race_Eth  + Confidence_Internet + SelfReportedHealth, descriptivesdataHD, topclass = "Rtable1-zebra") 

```

7- Table 1
```{r}
Table1<- table1(~ AgeRange + Sex + Rurality + Race_Eth  + Confidence_Internet + SelfReportedHealth|arm, overall = "Total", rowlabelhead = "Variables", descriptivesdataHD) 

print(Table1)
```

8- Labels

```{r}
label(descriptivesdataHD$AgeRange) <- "Age (years)"
label(descriptivesdataHD$Sex) <- "Sex"
label(descriptivesdataHD$Race_Eth) <- "Race/Ethnicity"
label(descriptivesdataHD$Confidence_Internet) <- "Digital Confidence "
label(descriptivesdataHD$SelfReportedHealth) <- "Self Reported Health Status"
label(descriptivesdataHD$arm) <- "Intervention Arm"
label(descriptivesdataHD$Rurality) <- "Rural Status"
```


9- Export table into word docx
```{r}
ft <- t1flex(Table1) # convert to a flextable, easier to format

doc <- read_docx() %>% # creates word doc object in R and then adds flextable to it
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = "Table 1_HDONLY.docx") 

getwd()
```
